name: Mahasiot
title: Levitical singer in the temple
summary: Mahasiot was one of the Levitical musicians appointed by King David to serve in the temple service. His name is mentioned in connection with the organization of temple singing and music. He was part of the Levitical choir that served before the ark of the covenant.

keyEvents.title: Appointment as a temple singer
keyEvents.description: Mahasiot was appointed as one of the singers and musicians in the temple service during King David's organization of worship.

keyEvents.title: Service with harps
keyEvents.description: Mahasiot was assigned to play on harps according to the Alamot tone, as part of the Levitical orchestra that accompanied the ark of the covenant.

keyEvents.title: David's organization of the Levites
keyEvents.description: King David organized the Levites into divisions for singing and music at the house of the Lord, and Mahasiot was among those given a role.

keyEvents.title: The Ark of the Covenant Is Brought to Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: The Levites participated in the solemn procession when the Ark of the Covenant was brought up to Jerusalem with singing and music.

keyEvents.title: Worship Before the Ark
keyEvents.description: After the ark had been placed in the tent David had pitched, Mahasiot and the other Levites continued their service of praise and music before the Lord's ark.
